scope: Determine by live measurement whether the sindexer Jina MXFP4 embedder can run on Strix (RTX 5070 Laptop, SM120) and whether its output matches the B550 reference, then compare the three embedding tiers.

question_answered.mxfp4_on_strix_cuda: YES. The Triton MXFP4 matmul_ogs kernel from kernels-community/gpt-oss-triton-kernels compiles and runs on SM120. A direct probe with packed E2M1 weights and E8M0 scales returned MXFP4_MATMUL_OK shape (8, 64) dtype torch.bfloat16 finite True.
question_answered.real_embedder_on_strix: YES. The unmodified cuda_embed_server.py serving jina-code-embeddings-1.5b-block-gptq-mxfp4-32k was deployed on Strix and returns 1536-dim embeddings.
question_answered.output_agreement: cosine 0.99990560 (row 0) and 0.99990414 (row 1) against the B550 RTX 3090 Ti reference for the same two code inputs; max absolute element difference 1.241e-3 and 2.521e-3. The residual difference is likely MXFP4 kernel ordering/rounding between Ampere and Blackwell (a hypothesis: no ablation isolates the cause and only two rows were compared).
question_answered.npu_path: NOT TESTED. The Intel Arrow Lake NPU (/dev/accel/accel0) was not exercised; the MXFP4 embedder as shipped is a CUDA/Triton path, so an NPU route would need a different implementation.
question_answered.output_agreement_cause_hypothesis: likely MXFP4 kernel ordering/rounding between Ampere and Blackwell; not isolated by an ablation

three_tier_comparison.tier_role: Strix fits the interactive/low-volume slot (lowest GPU-path latency) and can host the exact 1536-dim MXFP4 model, which the CPU embedder cannot. B550's 3090 Ti remains the bulk-throughput tier.
three_tier_comparison.path_asymmetry_note: The 2.25x single-request latency ratio compares the B550 balancer path (:1238) with the direct Strix path (:1236), so it is not a GPU-only comparison.

non_claims: Strix was NOT put into the sindexer routing path; the embedder on Strix runs standalone on :1236 and no nginx balancer or LaunchAgent tunnel was created.
The NPU path is untested; the MXFP4 embedder is a CUDA/Triton implementation as shipped.
Two input rows on one host pair are not a parity suite; the 0.9999 cosine is a spot check, not a bit-exact acceptance gate.
Strix throughput numbers are from one batch of 32 and five single reps on an otherwise idle host; no sustained-load or thermal behavior was measured.
The invalid HF token on Strix is worked around, not fixed.
No B550 embedding service was stopped or modified for the Strix work; both B550 units remained active throughout.
The B550 GPU and CPU tier values are reused from evidence/qwen-b550-concurrency-fallback.json, not re-measured in this session.
The B550 GPU latency was measured through the nginx :1238 balancer and the Strix latency direct on :1236; the 2.25x latency ratio includes that path difference and is not a GPU-only comparison.
